sections.title: Pulse, live
sections.intro: A neon HUD of rings: every reading a ring of light around the big number, magenta on black. This is the real wallpaper, drawn in your browser by the app's own code. Tap the big gauge, and try Pulse's layouts and colours.

qr.alt: A QR code that opens Speedometer Live Wallpaper on Google Play

labels.screen: Speedometer Live Wallpaper, live: tap the big gauge to switch it
labels.gauge: Tap the big gauge to switch between power, CPU clock and speed, as on your phone.
labels.getNote: A browser can’t set your wallpaper. Get the app on Google Play, open Styles and pick this one.

sections.title: About Pulse
sections.intro: Pulse turns every reading into a ring of light around the big number, magenta on black.

items.alt: The Pulse style, as the wallpaper draws it
items.caption: Pulse, drawn by the app itself

items.title: €2.39, once
items.text: Buy Pulse once on Google Play and it's yours. On a new phone with the same Google account, it comes back by itself.

items.title: One dial, three jobs
items.text: The big gauge shows power, CPU clock or GPS speed. Tap it on your home screen to switch, as in every style.

items.title: Make it yours
items.text: Customize sets Pulse's colours and background, and its units, clock and warning lights.

items.title: Layouts, and your own
items.text: Most styles come in several layouts. You can also drag and resize the gauges and save your own.

sections.title: Layouts made with Pulse
sections.intro: Drivers built these layouts in Pulse and shared them in the app's layout market, most used first. Every layout works in every style.

sections.title: More styles
sections.intro: Every style runs live on its own page. Or try them all in your browser.

image.alt: The Vector style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Vector
items.text: A neon HUD in hexagons: a faceted sweep that thickens as it climbs and crisp thin digits, violet on black.

image.alt: The Horizon style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Horizon
items.text: A fighter jet's head-up display: sliding tapes, the value boxed between them and a time strip, green on black.

image.alt: The Classic style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Classic
items.text: The 2016 dashboard: five gauges, an LCD clock and warning lights.

image.alt: The Steel style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Steel
items.text: Classic, refined: satin chrome around spun graphite and an ice-white LCD.
